This is reachable through `create()` at line 173 and through `load()`/`bound()`. The staged launcher explicitly permits receipt refresh at [launch_blender_bridge.py:627](/private/tmp/castle-builder-008-candidate/scripts/launch_blender_bridge.py:627), and its refresh path calls `create()` at line 542.

The installed [v25 scene-access route:240](/Users/boandersson/Desktop/Blender_Project/scripts/modeling_operations.py:240) reserves directly without consulting the kernel handoff/barrier locks. With no canonical read guard during the refresh query, that old route can still admit an edit. A refresh transport failure or controller death also leaves no durable guard retaining the query’s unknown outcome. This is a source-derived failure path; I did not execute it.
